content:
The announcement that actor Robert Pattinson would be the next James Bond caused the sort of tizzy on the internet that social media was invented for.

Pattinson was reportedly selected to play the superspy over Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, Josh O’Connor and Nicholas Hoult.

Monday’s announcement on the official James Bond X account that Pattinson would be the next 007 caused double the excitement of a typical casting announcement.

People had thoughts ― both positive and negative ― about Pattinson playing Bond.
